description: Exact age in years, months and days from a date of birth (on today or any "on" date), with totals in months, weeks, days and hours, the weekday of birth, Hijri (Umm al-Qura) birth date and Hijri age, next birthday (Feb 29 birthdays fall on Feb 28 in common years), star sign, Chinese zodiac, the next 1,000-day milestone, and optionally the age gap to a second person. Dates are ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/age-calc/

onDate.description: Work out the age on this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: today.

otherBirthDate.description: Optional second person's date of birth, to compare.

name: calc_age
title: Age calculator
